description: This file defines internal data structures and functions for managing nodes within the Ginkgo testing framework, including node creation, decoration, and hierarchy management.

methods.name: UniqueNodeID
methods.description: Generates a unique node ID in a thread-safe manner by incrementing a global counter protected by a mutex.

methods.name: Labels.MatchesLabelFilter
methods.description: Checks if the label matches a given filter query.

methods.name: SemVerConstraints.MatchesSemVerFilter
methods.description: Checks if the version satisfies the semantic version constraints.

methods.name: ComponentSemVerConstraints.MatchesSemVerFilter
methods.description: Checks if the component's version satisfies the constraints.

methods.name: unionOf
methods.description: Combines multiple slices into one, removing duplicates.

methods.name: UnionOfLabels
methods.description: Returns the union of multiple Labels slices.

methods.name: UnionOfSemVerConstraints
methods.description: Returns the union of multiple SemVerConstraints slices.

methods.name: UnionOfComponentSemVerConstraints
methods.description: Merges multiple ComponentSemVerConstraints maps into one.

methods.name: PartitionDecorations
methods.description: Splits arguments into decoration and non-decoration slices.

methods.name: isDecoration
methods.description: Determines if an argument is a decoration based on its type.

methods.name: isSliceOfDecorations
methods.description: Checks if a slice contains only decoration elements.

methods.name: NewNode
methods.description: Creates a new Node with specified type, text, and optional decorations/args, handling validation and decoration parsing.

methods.name: extractBodyFunction
methods.description: Extracts a body function from an argument, supporting various function signatures and marking deprecations.

methods.name: extractSynchronizedBeforeSuiteProc1Body
methods.description: Extracts a body function for synchronized before suite setup, returning a byte slice and context flag.

methods.name: extractSynchronizedBeforeSuiteAllProcsBody
methods.description: Extracts a body function for synchronized before suite across multiple processes.

methods.name: TransformNewNodeArgs
methods.description: Applies registered NodeArgsTransformers to modify node creation arguments, supporting chaining.
